source: He points out the location of the graveyard on your map.

source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...
target:
传送门是可以在眨眼间将你传送出很远距离的工具。它们通常需要一件关键道具来激活。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向西方，通向灼烧之痕——一个能带来死亡的活火山……

source: The target is lit up by a flare, reducing its stealth and invisibility power by %d, defense by %d and removing all evasion bonus from being unseen.
target: 目标被照明弹照亮，潜行和隐身强度减少 %d，闪避减少 %d 并失去不可见状态带来的闪避加成。
在 10 码范围内随机传送你。

source:

Fatigue is a percentile value that increases the cost of your talents and spells.
It represents the fatigue created by wearing heavy equipment.
Not all talents are affected; notably, Wild Gifts are not.

#GOLD#疲劳值#LAST#
疲劳值是你施放法术和技能时增加消耗的一个百分比。
它代表穿戴重甲时所造成的疲劳。
并不是所有技能都受疲劳值影响，例如，野性系就不受影响。

deep_observation: 机制错误：源串限定 "your Bash and Smash shield hits"，仅指该技能的盾击部分必定暴击。核对 t-engine4 commit 624a673 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/buckler-training.lua:173-197（SKIRMISHER_BUCKLER_MASTERY 的 info 拼接该句）与 :167（SKIRMISHER_BASH_AND_SMASH 的 info：先用盾牌击打并击退，随后「follow with a deadly short-range sling attack」），可见该技能含盾击与投石索射击两段伤害，保证暴击只覆盖盾击。译文「你的击退射击必定暴击」删去 shield 限定，而「击退射击」正是本仓 mod-tome.lua:30245 对 Bash and Smash 的既定译名、字面含「射击」，读者会理解为含投石索射击在内全部命中必暴，扩大了机制范围。建议补出盾击限定，如「你的击退射击的盾击必定暴击」。
source: At talent level 5, your Bash and Smash shield hits are guaranteed criticals.
surface_observation: “Bash and Smash shield hits”被误译为“击退射击”，且源文开头空格丢失
target: 技能等级 5，你的击退射击必定暴击。

source: A class talent allows you to perform new combat moves, cast spells, and improve your character. It represents the core function of your class. You gain one point every level and two every 5th level. You may also find trainers or artifacts that allow you to learn more.
target: 职业技能让你能够施展新的战斗招式、施放法术并强化角色。它代表你职业的核心功能。你每升 1 级获得一点职业技能点，每第 5 级获得两点，也可以通过训练师或神器获得更多。

source: I am back from the Charred Scar, where the orcs took the staff.
target: 我从灼烧之痕回来，兽人在那里抢走了法杖。

source:
The sandworms go from strength to strength
Ever greater do they seem
Of towering height and massive length
It is all as if a dream...

To the darkest depths I now depart
In search of my one fate
How I long to taste the beating heart
Of the legendary worm so great!
target:
沙虫的力量节节攀升
身躯似乎也越发庞大
高高耸立，身躯长得惊人
一切恍若梦境……

如今我要奔赴最黑暗的深处
追寻我唯一的宿命
我多么渴望尝一尝
那条传奇巨虫搏动的心脏！

deep_observation: 术语/语义错误：Self-Judgement 在 t-engine4 commit 624a673 game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/self-hatred.lua:154-203 为 cursed/hatred 第四技能，callbackOnTakeDamage 把超过最大生命 %d%% 的溢出伤害转为流血（dam = dam - reduce，并 setEffect EFF_SELF_JUDGEMENT），日志为「mitigating the blow!」，info 旁白为「You can't just die. That would be too easy.」；对应 timed_effects/other.lua:4161-4170 的 desc/on_gain/on_lose 均属该减伤机制。语义是「对自身的审判／裁决」，而译文「自裁」在现代汉语中固定表示自杀，与「避免直接死亡、把致死伤害改判为流血」的机制正好相反，会误导玩家。建议改为「自我审判」一类译法；该名在 mod-tome.lua:24480、36922、36925、36927 共四处一致使用，修复需同批覆盖。
surface_observation: Self-Judgement 表示“自我审判”，译为通常表示自杀的“自裁”造成明显语义偏移

source:
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
This one looks even nastier and looks toward you with what seems to be disdain. Flames swirl all around him.
target:
炎魔是高智慧的火焰元素，在火山以外的其他地方很少看到。它们很可能不属于这个世界。
这只看起来更加凶残，它用蔑视的眼神看着你。火焰在它的身上流转。

deep_observation: 语义错误：源串 "making sharp angles and turns"（t-engine4 commit 624a673 game/modules/tome/data/zones/scintillating-caves/zone.lua:99，进入闪光洞穴第一层的 on_enter 弹窗）描述魔法把地形扭曲成尖锐的棱角与折转。译文「使其变得规整而曲折」中的「规整」意为整齐规则，既未译出 sharp（尖锐），又给出与「扭曲（distorted）」相抵触的整齐印象；只有「曲折」勉强对应 turns。建议改为「棱角尖锐、曲折难行」一类表述。
source: As you enter the caves you notice the magic here has distorted the land, making sharp angles and turns.
surface_observation: sharp angles 被译为“规整”，与原文所述的尖锐折角语义相反
target: 当你走进洞穴时，你发现这里已经被魔法力量扭曲了，使其变得规整而曲折。
